component.name: SimpleScheduler
component.summary: A native home for your Linux scripts and routines

description.p: Find your scripts, give them a rhythm, and see how every run went. SimpleScheduler is a native GNOME application built with GTK 4 and libadwaita.

ul.li: Automatically discover readable scripts in watched folders
Create and edit scripts with syntax highlighting
Run on login, system startup, a calendar schedule, or an interval
Keep schedules running after the app closes
Inspect run history and captured output
